instrument_type_details.notes: FedEx manages fuel price risk primarily through fuel surcharge programs linked to prevailing market prices, not financial derivatives. All jet fuel hedging contracts were closed out as of May 31, 2001. FX derivatives exist for currency risk but not fuel.

throughput.source_quote: Item 7: 'During 2003, fuel costs were higher, due to a 16% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel.' No specific gallon volume disclosed.
